# Vikram Chopra
Founder of Cars24. Essays on car ownership in India, trust as the product, AI-native companies, and leadership.

## Mobility, Ownership, and Trust
- [The Second-Owner Decade](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/the-coming-decade-of-car-ownership-in-india/): India's next ownership wave may be built through used cars, reliable transfers, and support that makes ownership easier to enter.
- [Nobody Buys a Used Car. They Buy an EMI.](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/used-car-ownership-is-a-lending-problem/): India's used-car market grows when financing makes ownership reachable and lenders can understand the car they are backing.
- [The Greenest Car in India Is the One Already Built](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/the-greenest-car-in-india-is-the-one-already-built/): Keeping existing vehicles useful can reduce the need for new manufacturing, but reuse only works when buyers can trust the vehicle and its history.
- [Why India Never Learns From Its Road Deaths](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/indias-road-deaths-are-a-trust-problem-not-a-traffic-problem/): Drivers make mistakes. India needs road-safety systems that can see what happened, respond, and learn before the same failure kills again.
- [Why We Are Not Selling Cars](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/why-we-are-not-selling-cars/): The lasting business in mobility is not moving a vehicle once. It is making ownership more certain.

## Organization, AI, and Company Design
- [Companies Scale at the Speed They Learn](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/scale-is-a-learning-problem/): Hiring can add capacity, but a company scales well when it can see reality, learn, and change as complexity grows.
- [AI-Native Is Not AI-First. The Shape of the Company Is the AI Strategy.](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/ai-native-is-not-ai-first/): Adding AI to an old workflow can make it better. The deeper change is to rebuild how a company carries context and makes decisions.
- [We Deleted Every Title Except Builder](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/builder-is-the-only-role-left/): Cars24 changed its old title system. The deeper question is how to give people closer to a problem the context and responsibility to act.
- [Execution Problems Begin as Trust Problems](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/execution-problems-begin-as-trust-problems/): Delay and weak accountability often show up as process problems. Some begin earlier, when people do not trust one another enough to speak plainly or commit to a decision.
- [AI Will Let India Export Consumer Companies](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/ai-will-do-for-consumer-what-saas-did-for-software/): SaaS helped Indian companies sell software around the world. AI may make it easier for India-born consumer companies to carry operating knowledge across markets.

## Judgment, Desire, and Human Nature
- [The Paranoid Survive. The Regulated Thrive.](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/paranoid-survive-regulated-thrive/): Stay alert to the work and steady in yourself. Andy Grove gave us half the sentence. The other half is what helps us keep our judgment.
- [Who Taught You to Want This?](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/who-taught-you-to-want-this/): Much of what we call ambition is shaped by peers, rivals, and status systems before we recognize their influence. Asking where a desire came from can help us choose what to pursue.
- [You Had Reasons. They Had Flaws.](https://vikramchopra.in/posts/you-judge-others-by-character-and-yourself-by-circumstance/): We often explain our own behavior with context and other people's with character. That shortcut can make us miss the pressures and conditions that shaped what happened.
